name: ghostship
description: Ghostship — an autonomous software factory as a Claude Code plugin. One orchestrator skill runs a project test-first through intake → PRD → design → acceptance checks (STOP 1) → phased plan → TDD build with builder/judge subagents → release (STOP 2). Reliability comes from strong subagent contracts and, as they are added, mods (hooks) that enforce the process.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after each reply: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on API keys and cloud providers unless promptCacheTtl is set to 1h. The engine's own figure wins when a model switch reports it.
